siteDescriptionShort: Software engineer specializing in mobile development, AWS cloud, and interactive apps. Founder of Sentzel Labs. Published IEEE VR 2023 researcher.
siteDescription: Kadir Lofca is a software engineer with a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro. He builds consumer and enterprise products at scale, with deep experience in mobile development (Flutter, iOS, Android), AWS cloud infrastructure, and interactive applications. He is the founder of Sentzel Labs and has published award-winning research on XR authentication at IEEE VR 2023.
